prompt:
Create a high-fidelity professional MOBILE UX/UI mockup presentation for Palla, an organizer's SESSION OCCURRENCE DETAIL screen, adapted faithfully from a supplied HTML "Manage Session & Roster" reference. One polished coherent design, shown as THREE adjacent mobile viewport artboards representing scroll positions of the SAME screen, not three different design variants. Output a landscape design board about 1600x1250. NO device frames, mock phones, desk, browser chrome or photographs of phones. Each artboard is a real flat app interface ~390 wide, tall, spaced on a warm neutral outer presentation ground. Small labels outside artboards only: "01 · Session overview", "02 · Players & waitlist", "03 · Organizer controls". Tiny outer caption "Concept · illustrative player data". The screens themselves must look like professionally shipped React Native iOS/Android UI with readable body text 16px equivalent, excellent spacing, clear hierarchy and 48px tap targets.

PINNED PALLA VISUAL SYSTEM: light only, pale almost-white lavender canvas #fbf8ff, white #ffffff surfaces, soft lavender #f4f2fd supporting areas, near-black #1a1b22 type, olive #536600 accents, fluorescent lime #d4ff00 as restrained principal action fill, subtle #e3e1ec hairline borders, #ba1a1a destructive action. Hanken Grotesk-like beautifully balanced sans display headings 28px bold and body 16px, Geist-like quiet labels. No gradients, glass, ornamental shadows, bento overload, pill-shaped giant controls or excess cards within cards. Rounded input/action corners 12-16px. Outline icons consistent thin lucide style. No dark mode. A recurring social padel session, not tournament scheduling. No decimal ratings, Euro currency, payment badges, Palla Pay, refunds, reliability scores, fake session IDs, organizer automatically added as player or analytics graphs.

Sticky header identical on all 3 artboards, safe status-bar padding: simple left chevron Back, title "Session details", edit outline icon right. No global bottom navigation, no top eyebrow. User is organizer managing THIS dated occurrence; recurrence is secondary context, visually distinct from the dated game. Clean scan-first composition.

ARTBOARD 1 SUMMARY:
Top tiny olive status "Published" next to muted small "Full".
Large title two lines "Tuesday social padel".
Clear date line calendar icon "Tue 20 Oct 2026", clock line "19:00–20:30 · Buenos Aires".
White restrained venue region: "Palermo Padel" bold, "Court 2", location icon "Av. Córdoba 1234, Buenos Aires", subtle olive "Open in Maps" link.
Two simple paired data columns with no nested rounded panels: "Categories" / "6ta–7ma"; "Per player" / "ARS 12,000"; below price small "Pay at the club".
Quiet lavender recurrence row repeat icon "Part of a weekly series", secondary "Tuesdays · through 17 Nov", chevron, olive link "View series". Context must not suggest changing the series via occurrence actions.
Section "Players" with "4 / 4 confirmed" and very restrained lime/olive capacity bar. Four overlapping small neutral initial avatars LM, MP, VR, TS and link "View players" with chevron. All sample data illustrative outside UI.
Bottom glimpse of "About this session" with copy "Friendly games for 6ta and 7ma players. Bring your racket and arrive 10 minutes early." Natural scrolling continuation no sticky publish button.

ARTBOARD 2 PLAYERS/WAITLIST scroll position:
Same sticky header, main section "Players" and "4 / 4 confirmed".
Four refined full-width roster rows with small circle initial avatars (not invented photographic portraits), player name, Argentine category quiet text, olive check and "Confirmed": "Lucía Moreno · 6ta", "Mateo Pérez · 7ma", "Valentina Ruiz · 6ta", "Tomás Silva · 7ma". Secondary small section explanation "Registered for Tue 20 Oct". Each row only tiny overflow outline dots at right; no messaging, pay badges, team averages. A full roster means no contradictory open slot.
Then "Waitlist" with count "2". Simple numbered queue rows "1  Sofía Torres · 6ta" and "2  David López · 7ma". Quiet inset lavender informational copy "If a player cancels, the next person in line gets the available place." This is a proposed MVP auto-waitlist UI; do not show manual promotion on a full session.
Below quiet supporting "Registration closes" / "Tue 20 Oct · 17:00". Reading sections separated by good whitespace and subtle horizontal rules, not all wrapped in competing cards.

ARTBOARD 3 CONTROLS lower scroll position:
Same sticky header.
"Session rules" heading. White/simple list rows with divider: "Registration closes" / "20 Oct · 17:00"; "Player cancellation deadline" / "19 Oct · 19:00"; "Payments" / "Arranged outside Palla".
"Organizer notes" heading and short copy "Court booked directly with the club. Players pay at reception."
"Manage this session" heading with helpful text "Changes apply to this date. You can choose future sessions in the next step."
Full-width fluorescent lime button pencil icon "Edit session".
Full-width outlined olive button repeat icon "View recurring series".
Below separate spaced red outlined full-width button "Cancel session".
Small plain note below "Cancelled sessions stay in your history." No refund promises, broadcast action, check-in features or notification claims, since not current MVP behavior.
One quiet footer note "Next session · Tue 27 Oct, 19:00".

Take primary layout cues from the supplied reference: task-focused top header, prominent occurrence facts, compact category and price comparison, practical roster, separate waitlist and clear organizer actions. Improve its clutter and product contradictions. Do not invent promotional prose, unavailable paid features, logos, decorative illustrations, bottom tabs, share buttons, or controls unrelated to session occurrence. Render all text accurately and legibly. This is a UI DESIGN BOARD, not code or a marketing poster.
scope: Organizer session occurrence detail; one screen at three scroll positions; illustrative registration data
